payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, utilizing a modality attention module to effectively combine these modalities.

claims.text: The proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model learns from both text and images, integrating visual information with textual data to enhance entity recognition.
The modality attention module in the MNER model selectively amplifies relevant visual contexts while integrating them with textual information for better NER performance.
